content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing frequent connection drops when using the [product_name] App. Reconnecting is difficult, although both the [product_name] configuration tool (using Mac) and the integrated webserver are functioning without issues. Currently, I have three [product_name] units along with several IO expansion modules for my home automation setup. These are all linked through a dedicated network switch, which connects to my home WiFi. I'm using the latest releases of both the [product_name] configuration tool and [product_name] App, and the issue appears on both iPad and iPhone. Has anyone encountered this, or have ideas for a solution? I've already tried adjusting access permissions, using different programs, performing uploads, power cycling, and changing the router... Much appreciated for any suggestions.

Hi, I'd recommend these steps, though I can't guarantee improved performance with the [product_name] App: 1. Update the firmware of your [product_name] device, as the display may stop functioning after about 50 days. Refer to relevant forum discussions for details. 2. Consider adding a newer [product_name] module, sharing data with your existing units, and using its custom web server. This lets you build personalized web pages without HTML coding and offers greater flexibility. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The primary user concern is the unstable connectivity between the mobile app and the [product_name] devices, observed on both iPad and iPhone. Users describe frequent disconnections and challenges in reestablishing connections. While other interfaces like the configuration tool (Mac) and built-in webserver operate reliably, mobile access remains inconsistent despite multiple troubleshooting attempts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want reliable and consistent mobile access to [product_name] controllers using the app, free from repeated connection failures. They expect equivalent functionality across device platforms and anticipate that standard troubleshooting will resolve connectivity issues.
